definition: running the linter over what stands and reading back what it found, changing nothing
a hook payload as the agent sends one, made so a test can hand it to a hook
statement: The payload is built to the shape the agent sends.

definition: the commit the index was built from
statement: The stamp names the commit the index was built from.

definition: a place a name appears, and the format it is written in there
statement: A place says where a name appears and which format holds there.

definition: one refusal standing for the whole command line it was found in
statement: One refused call refuses the line.

definition: the indexes the pages are read through, each answering one question of them
statement: An index answers one question of the pages.

definition: an index from an identifier to the page carrying it
statement: No two pages carry one id.

definition: a bound the work is done within
statement: A constraint bounds how the work is done rather than stating what is not yet so.

definition: code, data and text in a page with a type in a file
how much of the five-hour allowance is spent
statement: An account that has spent its seven-day window has spent its five-hour one.

definition: a page property holding a single point in time
statement: An instant is written as ISO 8601 in UTC to the millisecond and closes with `Z`.

definition: whole file bodies carried in, gated together and landed or refused as one
statement: A body reaches this only as a file named at `--content-file` rather than on the command line.

definition: a module run over a change to judge whether it may land
statement: Patch turns on before the tree's violation count reaches zero.

definition: files carried to new paths, with what they name and what names them repointed in the same act
statement: The bodies a move carries and repoints are read from the commit it stood on rather than from the working tree.
